subject: Change of Billing Entity & Invoice Routing for Acme Holdings consolidation
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acmeholdings.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: diego.ramos@acmeholdings.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming ledger consolidation — billing entity and invoices

Hi Karthik,

Following Acme Holdings' closing of the Parkside acquisition, our finance team is consolidating ledgers under Acme Holdings, Inc. We need Redwood to start issuing invoices to the holding entity (Acme Holdings, Inc., EIN: 12-3456789) and change remit instructions for future payments.

Concrete asks:
- Can you reissue June invoice #202706-12345 to Acme Holdings, Inc.?
- Confirm the billing address and remit-to details you will show on the invoice.
- Send required tax/VAT docs we need on file (supplier VAT cert or W-9 equivalent).

I attached a draft remit file and the official consolidation notice. We'll need to cutover on July 1 if possible. Diego in AP is copied to coordinate payment timing.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Gomez
Accounting Manager, Acme Holdings
attachments: acme_new_remit_instructions.pdf, acme_consolidation_notice.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acmeholdings.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming ledger consolidation — billing entity and invoices

Marta — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the close. We've looped in Finance (Laura) and Billing Ops (Priyom) to handle reissue and the remit switch. Quick answers:

- We can reissue the June invoice to Acme Holdings, Inc.; we need a signed acceptance (email is fine) and the exact legal name and tax ID — you've provided the EIN which helps.
- Please confirm the remit address to appear on the invoice; we'll mirror what's in acme_new_remit_instructions.pdf unless you flag changes.
- We'll attach Redwood's supplier tax cert (US W-9) and a vendor data form — Laura, can you add the tax docs?

Priyom will handle the invoice reissue and follow up on any PO/DocuSign requirements. If July 1 is the cutover, we should complete the reissue and routing by end of week to avoid delays.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acmeholdings.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming ledger consolidation — billing entity and invoices

Hi Marta — attaching the supplier tax docs.

Attachments: redwood_w9_2027.pdf, vendor-data-form.pdf

We can reissue invoice 202706-12345 to Acme Holdings, Inc. and send it to accounts-payable@acmeholdings.com. 
Operational notes:
- Reissued invoice will carry the original invoice date (2027-06-15) and show 'Bill To' as Acme Holdings, Inc.
- Payment terms will remain Net 30 unless you provide a PO with different terms.
- For VAT reporting, if you need a vendor VAT certificate from us, please confirm the jurisdiction and any VAT ID you expect on the invoice.

Priyom, please prepare the reissued PDF and route to Marta + Diego.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acmeholdings.com>, diego.ramos@acmeholdings.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming ledger consolidation — billing entity and invoices

Hi Marta / Diego — attaching the reissued invoice and the vendor VAT certificate you requested. Per our internal notes:

- Attached: redwood-invoice-202706-12345.pdf (reissued to Acme Holdings, Inc.)
- Attached: acme_vat_certificate_2027.pdf (vendor-provided for your records)
- We'll send future monthly invoices to accounts-payable@acmeholdings.com and copy karthik_iyer@redwood.com.

Next steps for you: Please confirm acceptance of the reissued invoice and advise if you require a different remit-to bank reference or a PO number for Accounts Payable.

Attachments: reissued_invoice_202706-12345.pdf, redwood_vat_2027.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@acmeholdings.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acmeholdings.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming ledger consolidation — billing entity and invoices

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few items before we finalize:

1) We received the reissued invoice and confirm 'Bill To' is correct. Please include Acme Holdings VAT ID: GB999888777 on the header for our EU reporting.
2) For the July invoice onward, our AP team prefers invoices routed with our PO reference. I'll issue a PO next week and share the number.
3) We are consolidating payment windows; July payments may be delayed by up to 7 business days while we complete bank signoffs. Can you confirm Redwood's acceptance of that potential short delay?

On point 3: an email confirmation is fine; we don't need renegotiated terms.

Diego Ramos
AP Lead, Acme Holdings
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@acmeholdings.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acmeholdings.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming ledger consolidation — billing entity and invoices

Diego / Marta — confirming final plan and sign-off from Redwood:

- Reissued invoice 202706-12345 has been sent to accounts-payable@acmeholdings.com and shows Acme Holdings, Inc. as the billed entity (EIN: 12-3456789).
- We will include Acme Holdings VAT ID GB999888777 on EU-facing invoice headers starting with July billing.
- Redwood accepts the possible 7-business-day payment delay for July due to your internal bank signoffs; we'll treat it as a one-time variance and won't assess late fees.
- Please share the PO when available; we'll include it on subsequent invoices.
- Stephanie (ops) will be the point of contact for any remittance bank detail changes — stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com.

Action items closed: reissue sent; VAT ID request acknowledged; payment timing accepted. If you need a DocuSign confirmation for the remit change, we can route the envelope—link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-ACME-2027

Appreciate the partnership and congrats again on the consolidation.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: acme_new_remit_instructions.pdf
